%SQL.Statement.purpose: The standard way to prepare and execute dynamic SQL in IRIS / Cache. Replaces the older %ResultSet API.
%SQL.Statement.source: InterSystems class reference; Caché 2013.1 release notes.

%Library.DynamicArray.purpose: Native JSON array type. Pairs with %Library.DynamicObject for ergonomic JSON construction and parsing.

%Library.DynamicObject.purpose: Native JSON object type. Use with %Set, %Get, %ToJSON, %FromJSON for dynamic JSON manipulation.

%CSP.Documatic.purpose: Web-based class reference browser. Reachable at /csp/documatic/ to inspect any class.

%Stream.GlobalCharacter.purpose: Globals-backed character stream. Standard storage for large text fields.

%Net.HttpRequest.purpose: Outbound HTTP client used across IRIS interop and ad-hoc API calls.

%SYS.Python.purpose: Embedded Python bridge — call Python from ObjectScript and vice versa.

%Embedding.Interface.purpose: Vector embedding interface — feeds the new VECTOR data type for semantic search / RAG workloads.

%Wallet.purpose: No class named %Wallet ships in standard IRIS / IRIS for Health distributions. It may be a custom or third-party class.
%Wallet.source: Confirmed absent from %Dictionary.ClassDefinition in stock IRIS for Health 2026.2.
